name: Dino Smile: Herbivore Grinding Tools (Square Aspect)
description: A comparative diagram for the game 'Dino Smile', presenting three distinct types of herbivorous dinosaur dental batteries optimized for a 1:1 square game card format to illustrate specialization for plant-milling, entirely excluding carnivorous dentition.
style: 3D render, realistic bone and enamel textures with illustrative cross-sections arranged in a balanced, clean layout across three primary focal zones

color_palette.background_matrix: Natural stone greys and warm tans

key_elements.description: A complex cross-section showing thousands of interlocking diamond-shaped teeth tightly packed into vertical columns, specifically showing a Hadrosaurid jaw mechanism.
key_elements.label: DIAMOND BATTERY (Hadrosaur)
key_elements.state: Complex milling tool showcasing hundreds of replacement teeth waiting below the surface.

key_elements.description: A visual representation showing a matrix of teeth interlocking in a hexagonal, honeycomb-like pattern, creating a massive shearing and grinding surface typical of Ceratopsians.
key_elements.label: HONEYCOMB BATTERY (Ceratopsian)
key_elements.state: Continuous grinding pavement optimized for slicing tough fibrous vegetation.

key_elements.description: A close-up and illustrative cross-section of multi-pointed, spoon-shaped or 'forked' edge teeth arranged in a compact, overlapping sequence found in sauropodomorphs and early ornithischians.
key_elements.label: FORKED BATTERY (Sauropodomorph)
key_elements.state: Plant shredder and raking tool used to strip leaves from woody stems.

context_graphics.description: The stylized 'Dino Smile' logo centered at the absolute bottom margin of the square canvas.
context_graphics.state: Integrated branding for the game card layout

usage: Texture mapping for interactive educational square tiles
Digital game asset (standard square card icon)
Printable square card for physical tabletop gameplay
